intro: Oman has about 5 million people, with many foreign workers alongside Omanis.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Omanis are Ibadi Muslims, with Sunni and Shia minorities. Arabic is official, and Baluchi, Swahili and South Arabian languages like Mehri are also spoken, a sign of old links across the sea.

chapters.title: Life
text: Omanis are known for hospitality and tolerance. Men wear the dishdasha and an embroidered cap or turban.

keyTerms.meaning: A long robe worn by Omani men.
